statement.ru: «Мона Лиза» написана на холсте.
statement.en: The Mona Lisa is painted on canvas.

why: It is oil on a white poplar wood panel.

statement.ru: Прежде чем стать художником, Ван Гог был проповедником у шахтёров.
statement.en: Before he became a painter, Van Gogh was a preacher among coal miners.

why: In 1879 he worked as a missionary in the Borinage coal-mining district of Belgium.

statement.ru: Голых людей на «Страшном суде» Микеланджело позже прикрыли нарисованной одеждой.
statement.en: The naked figures in Michelangelo's Last Judgment were later covered with painted-on clothes.

why: Many nudes in The Last Judgment were later partly covered with painted draperies.

statement.ru: Леонардо да Винчи закончил больше сотни картин.
statement.en: Leonardo da Vinci finished more than a hundred paintings.

why: Fewer than 25 major works are attributed to him, many unfinished.

statement.ru: Рембрандт — это имя художника, а не фамилия.
statement.en: Rembrandt is the painter's first name, not his surname.

why: Full name Rembrant Harmenszoon van Rijn: Harmenszoon is a patronymic, van Rijn the family name.

statement.ru: «Герника» Пикассо — яркая картина в красных и жёлтых тонах.
statement.en: Picasso's Guernica is a bright painting in reds and yellows.

why: Guernica is painted only in grey, black and white.

statement.ru: «Мона Лиза» какое-то время висела в спальне Наполеона.
statement.en: For a while the Mona Lisa hung in Napoleon's bedroom.

why: It spent a brief period in Napoleon's bedroom in the Tuileries Palace.

statement.ru: Художник Караваджо убил человека и бежал из Рима.
statement.en: The painter Caravaggio killed a man and fled Rome.

why: He killed Ranuccio Tomassoni in a brawl, was sentenced to death and fled to Naples.

statement.ru: Картина Дали с растекающимися часами — огромная, во всю стену.
statement.en: Dalí's painting of the melting clocks is huge, the size of a whole wall.

why: The Persistence of Memory is small: about 24 × 33 cm.

statement.ru: Фрида Кало собиралась стать врачом, но попала в аварию.
statement.en: Frida Kahlo was going to be a doctor, but then she was in an accident.

why: She was headed for medical school until a bus accident at 18; she took up painting while recovering.

statement.ru: Слово «импрессионизм» художники придумали себе сами как гордое название.
statement.en: The Impressionists made up the word 'Impressionism' themselves as a proud name.

why: A critic, Louis Leroy, coined it in a mocking 1874 review of Monet's Impression, Sunrise.

statement.ru: Коричневую краску сепию делали из чернил каракатицы.
statement.en: The brown paint sepia was made from cuttlefish ink.

why: Sepia is named after the pigment from the ink sac of the common cuttlefish.

statement.ru: Пикассо за всю жизнь создал меньше тысячи работ.
statement.en: Picasso made fewer than a thousand works in his whole life.

why: His estate alone held over 45,000 unsold works, including 1,885 paintings.

statement.ru: Картины Уорхола с Мэрилин Монро однажды прострелили из револьвера.
statement.en: Warhol's paintings of Marilyn Monroe were once shot through with a revolver.

why: In 1964 Dorothy Podber fired a revolver through a stack of four Marilyn canvases.

statement.ru: Мунк написал «Крик» в одном-единственном экземпляре.
statement.en: Munch made The Scream as one single painting, with no other versions.

why: Munch made two painted versions, two pastels and a lithograph.

statement.ru: Старые мастера замешивали краски на яичном желтке.
statement.en: The old masters mixed their paints with egg yolk.

why: Egg tempera, pigment bound with egg yolk, was a main painting medium before oils.

statement.ru: Дега больше всего любил рисовать боксёров.
statement.en: Degas's favourite subject was boxers.

why: More than half of his works depict dancers.

statement.ru: Бэнкси тайком вешал свои картины в музеях Нью-Йорка.
statement.en: Banksy secretly hung his own pictures in New York museums.

why: In March 2005 he placed his works in MoMA, the Met and other New York museums.

statement.ru: После смерти Вермеера о нём почти на двести лет забыли.
statement.en: After Vermeer died, he was almost forgotten for two hundred years.

why: He fell into obscurity for nearly two centuries until his rediscovery in the 19th century.

statement.ru: Рембрандт до самой смерти жил в богатстве.
statement.en: Rembrandt lived in wealth until the day he died.

why: He went insolvent in 1656 and had to give up his house and collection.

statement.ru: Поллок писал картины, разбрызгивая краску на холст, лежащий на полу.
statement.en: Pollock painted by dripping paint onto a canvas lying on the floor.

why: He laid his canvases on the studio floor and developed his 'drip' technique.

statement.ru: Золото на «Поцелуе» Климта — это просто жёлтая краска.
statement.en: The gold in Klimt's The Kiss is just yellow paint.

why: The Kiss is oil on canvas with real gold leaf added, plus silver and platinum.

statement.ru: Сальвадор Дали работал над мультфильмом вместе с Уолтом Диснеем.
statement.en: Salvador Dalí worked on a cartoon together with Walt Disney.

why: Destino began in 1945 as a collaboration between Disney and Dalí, finished in 2003.

statement.ru: Моне и Мане — один и тот же художник, просто имя пишут по-разному.
statement.en: Monet and Manet are the same painter; his name is just spelled two ways.

why: Édouard Manet and Claude Monet were two different painters and friends.

statement.ru: Белую краску художники веками делали из свинца.
statement.en: For centuries, painters' white paint was made from lead.

why: Lead white was the main white pigment from antiquity until the 19th century.

statement.ru: Рафаэль дожил до глубокой старости.
statement.en: Raphael lived to a ripe old age.

why: He was born in 1483 and died in 1520, aged 37.

statement.ru: Уорхол годами складывал всякий хлам в коробки и набил их больше шестисот.
statement.en: For years Warhol packed odds and ends into boxes and filled more than six hundred.

why: His 610 Time Capsules hold everyday stuff, from mail to cake.

statement.ru: Фрида Кало писала в основном огромные фрески на стенах.
statement.en: Frida Kahlo painted mostly huge murals on walls.

why: She painted mostly small self-portraits; murals were her husband Diego Rivera's work.

statement.ru: Матисс в старости создавал картины, вырезая их ножницами из бумаги.
statement.en: In old age Matisse made pictures by cutting them out of paper with scissors.

why: When illness stopped him painting, he made a major body of work in cut paper collage.

statement.ru: «Тайная вечеря» Леонардо написана по сырой штукатурке, как обычная фреска.
statement.en: Leonardo's Last Supper was painted on wet plaster, like an ordinary fresco.

why: He painted it in tempera on a dry wall, which is why it decayed so fast.

statement.ru: Когда-то на Олимпийских играх давали медали за живопись.
statement.en: Medals were once given for painting at the Olympic Games.

why: From 1912 to 1948 the Olympics awarded medals in art, painting included.

statement.ru: Масляные краски изобрели только в XIX веке.
statement.en: Oil paints were invented only in the 19th century.

why: The earliest known oil paintings are 7th-century Buddhist murals in Afghanistan.

statement.ru: Под трубкой на знаменитой картине Магритта написано «Это не трубка».
statement.en: Under the pipe in Magritte's famous painting are the words 'This is not a pipe'.

why: Magritte painted 'Ceci n'est pas une pipe' under the pipe.

statement.ru: Вермеер оставил после себя больше пятисот картин.
statement.en: Vermeer left behind more than five hundred paintings.

why: Only 34 paintings are universally attributed to him.

statement.ru: Уинстон Черчилль написал больше 500 картин.
statement.en: Winston Churchill painted more than 500 pictures.

why: He took up painting in 1915 and painted over 500 pictures.

statement.ru: Рубенс прославился портретами очень худых женщин.
statement.en: Rubens was famous for painting very thin women.

why: He loved painting full-figured women; hence the word 'Rubenesque'.

statement.ru: На картине Боттичелли Венера выходит из моря верхом на дельфине.
statement.en: In Botticelli's painting, Venus rises from the sea riding a dolphin.

why: She stands in a giant scallop shell.

statement.ru: Право на сверхчёрный Vantablack в искусстве получил всего один художник.
statement.en: Only one artist got the right to use the ultra-black Vantablack in art.

why: Surrey NanoSystems gave Anish Kapoor exclusive rights to it for artistic use.

statement.ru: Гоген уехал от цивилизации писать картины в Африку.
statement.en: Gauguin left civilisation behind to paint in Africa.

why: He went to Tahiti and the Marquesas Islands in Polynesia.

statement.ru: Сёра писал картины из тысяч крошечных цветных точек.
statement.en: Seurat made his paintings out of thousands of tiny coloured dots.

why: Seurat and Signac developed pointillism, painting in small distinct dots of colour.

statement.ru: «Ночной дозор» Рембрандта обрезали, чтобы он влез на новое место.
statement.en: Rembrandt's Night Watch was cut down to fit in a new place.

why: In 1715 it was trimmed on all four sides to fit between two columns in the Town Hall.
